audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer said Diana on all seven rows; the content layer and the packet both read Lux, Lux, Diana, Diana, Skill, Lux, Lux. Every row disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Lux pokes a dashless Diana at 1175/1100 for the first two levels; Lunar Rush at level 3 flips it; by Zhonya's and range items Lux stalls the dive and re-takes the poke war.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side = Lux, phases[4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Lux (rows 2 and 3 already said Diana), with the whys rewritten in the same proposal. Content win[0..6] already matched the packet, so no win[] edits were required.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and whys[3] both claim Diana has no gap-closer until level 6 / that level 6 gives her Lunar Rush. That is false. spikes[] also had 3 entries where 4 are expected.
audit.why: Lunar Rush is Diana's E, available from level 3, at 825 range and 22/20/18/16/14s — and it has no cooldown at all when it targets a Moonlight-marked enemy. Level 6 gives Moonfall, a 475-range pull on 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and whys[3] corrected; spikes[3] added for the level-3 Lunar Rush spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the actual mechanic that decides the lane: Crescent Strike's Moonlight mark makes Lunar Rush free, and casting Lunar Rush at anything else strips the mark.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used on a Moonlight-afflicted enemy, and all other enemies lose Moonlight regardless. So dodging the Q arc turns her dash back into a 22-second cooldown, and Pale Cascade (15s down to 9s) is the shield that eats your poke.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dosFull[1] and dontsFull[2] now carry the reset rule with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[2].d called Crescent Strike a "fifteen-second" cooldown.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Prismatic Barrier has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Crescent Strike (Q): 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — its Moonlight mark is what makes Lunar Rush free, so sidestep the arc. - Lunar Rush (E) is 22s at rank 1 without a mark. - Moonfall is 100s at rank 1, and Prismatic Barrier is 12s: shield the pull, not the poke.
